title: Elenilda S
content: Today, 15 months after what happened to me, I discovered I had an NDE. I underwent a major high-risk surgery in March 2024. It was a debulking procedure for stage IV metastatic ovarian cancer affecting 13 organs. The peritoneum had overtaken and 3 liters of abnormal build-up of fluid in the abdomen. Survival was unlikely, but today I am in remission, thank God.

elements.At the time of your experience, was ther: Yes, Illness, Surgery-related, Life threatening event, but not clinical death
elements.How did your highest level of consciousn: Normal consciousness and alertness, I didn't notice any difference.
elements.At what time during the experience were: After the distress of not being able to breathe, it was as if I slowed down. Everything stopped making sense or being necessary. At one point, there was no more shortness of breath, and the discomfort gave way to peace. I was just there, contemplating that moment. It was the light and me; held by that thin thread that, despite being delicate, kept me secure, and I wasn't afraid of anything.
elements.Did time seem to speed up or slow down?: Everything seemed to be happening at once; or time stopped or lost all meaning, Time didn't matter; it wasn't relevant. I didn't think about time, but it held no significance.
elements.Please compare your vision during the ex: It became more detailed, observing every little thing.
elements.Please compare your hearing during the e: I don't believe there was any change.
elements.Did you seem to be aware of things going: Yes, but the facts have not been checked out
elements.Did you see an unearthly light?: Yes, A very bright but extremely comforting light. It came from above in the sky. Yet at the same time, it felt close.
elements.What emotions did you feel during the ex: Peace, a deep sense of peace, complete trust, and happiness to be entirely in God's hands. I knew that despite the situation, I would return.
elements.Did your experience include features con: Content that was entirely consistent with the beliefs you had at the time of your experience, It is consistent in affirming that our life does not end here. There is something more.
elements.During your experience, did you gain inf: Yes, The thread connecting me to the Light is what sustains life.
Yes, I wasn't dreaming. I was fully aware that I had not died and that I wouldn't die. God sustained me through that thread. Life and death are in His hands.
Yes, The light, besides peace, radiated love that was enveloping, which is why I felt so strongly embraced and knew everything would turn out well.
elements.What life changes occurred in your life: I am more grateful for each day lived. I value the care people show me and their friendship even more.
elements.Was the experience difficult to express: Yes, No matter how much I can describe it in detail, it's impossible to convey the sensation I had.
elements.How accurately do you remember the exper: I remember the experience more accurately than other life events that occurred around the time of the experience, I don't remember many things that happened when I woke from the coma, but the experience remains vivid in my memory.
elements.Did you have any knowledge of near death: Yes, Yes, I had seen some accounts of this type of experience, but I didn't expect it to happen to me. I also don't believe that knowing about these experiences affected my knowledge, as it was only after some time that I realized my experience had been an NDE.
elements.What did you believe about the reality o: Experience was definitely real, Because it was and is very vivid in my mind.
elements.What do you believe about the reality of: Experience was definitely real, To me, it is as real as any memory.
elements.Did the questions asked and information: Yes, The account itself already contains everything that happened in the experience. There are no details left out.
